protocols.title: Reduced-EF history and therapy review
protocols.purpose: Find recorded reduced-EF history worth reconciling, including patients whose later EF may have improved, then inspect current dated measurements and medication reports.

sources.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA heart-failure guideline slide set
sources.interpretation: The EF classification threshold motivates a review screen. Improved EF does not erase prior reduced-EF history. Titration depends on tolerability and clinical context.

low_ef_history.label: Recorded EF at or below 40% in the available history

dated_low_ef.label: Latest explicitly dated EF can be interpreted

raas_use.label: ARNi use report interpreted (ACEi/ARB alternatives still require review)

protocols.review_action: Reconcile the recorded EF trajectory and therapy history with the clinical team; determine indication, current regimen, appropriate exceptions and tolerability before considering a medication change.
unimplemented_clinical_requirements: Current vital signs, labs, contraindications and maximum tolerated dose
protocols.boundary: A historical low EF or a known medication report is not a diagnosis, verified current use, under-treatment, or authorization to initiate/titrate. This is not a full GDMT protocol.

protocols.title: Low-eGFR evidence and specialist follow-through
protocols.purpose: Find adults with a low recorded eGFR for evidence review, then inspect explicit clinical timing and nephrology completion accounts without inferring missing care.

sources.title: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline
sources.interpretation: The adult-CKD referral figure includes eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 among multiple indications. A single abnormal result does not establish CKD chronicity.

adult.label: Age at snapshot is at least 18

dated_low_egfr.label: Latest explicitly dated eGFR can be interpreted

protocols.review_action: Verify measurement timing and acute/chronic clinical context, then reconcile nephrology attendance and outside records before deciding whether a referral is indicated or missing.
unimplemented_clinical_requirements: Confirmed CKD chronicity and cause versus acute illness
All other guideline referral indications and patient-specific urgency
Verified specialist relationship and referral-to-visit identity
protocols.boundary: This is one guideline-informed review criterion. A nonmatch does not rule out referral, CKD or other kidney disease; an absent completion account does not prove missing specialist care.

protocols.title: Received affordability reports to assistance review
protocols.purpose: Use the pinned native affordability-screen requirement to propose review of reported difficulty paying medical bills, preserving source accounts, unknowns and separate assistance-program prerequisites.

barrier.label: Received report of difficulty paying medical bills

protocols.review_action: Verify current affordability needs and the patient's preferences, then assess applicable assistance benefits and application requirements.
unimplemented_clinical_requirements: Effective assistance-program eligibility and available benefits
protocols.boundary: Internal documentary review workflow, not a medical guideline, program enrollment or payer eligibility decision.
